items.title: The pope's South America tour
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Pope Leo embarks on a tour of South America next week. The trip will be a chance to connect with one of the strongest Catholic populations in the world and a personal voyage for a man who spent decades in Peru as a priest and bishop. On this episode of On Assignment, Vatican reporter Joshua McElwee and Latin America correspondent Cassandra Garrison talk about the Pope's recent health concerns, the Catholic Church's recent struggles in Latin America and what to expect from the trip.

items.content:

items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>Rescuers picked through mangled carriages in a search for victims of Spain's second fatal high-speed train crash this year, with the death toll rising to 69 and the public demanding explanations for the latest accident. Spain's Foreign Ministry said 42 foreign citizens from seven countries were involved in the crash, information available so far showed, of whom one was killed and at least seven injured.
